profiles.title: Paired cart demo
profiles.description: One local cart click with actual server and browser pauses.

items.title: Server cart mutation
items.overview: The server admits the selected cart request and adds the product to its cart state. The stop is immediately before that mutation. Source structure alone does not establish an observed execution.

items.title: Browser display update
items.overview: The browser awaits the selected cart response and updates the displayed count. The stop is immediately before the DOM update. Request correspondence requires a complete verified observation set.

profiles.title: Checkout demo
profiles.description: Add one local product, then create an order and observe purchase confirmation in the same application. No real payment.

items.title: Cart mutation
items.overview: The server admits the selected cart request and adds the product to its cart state. The stop is immediately before that mutation. Source structure alone does not establish an observed execution.

items.title: Cart update
items.overview: The browser awaits the selected cart response and updates the displayed count. The stop is immediately before the DOM update. Request correspondence requires a complete verified observation set.

items.title: Order creation
items.overview: The server checks the checkout request against the retained cart and derives the order total from its items. The stop is immediately before storing the order; its order count is still zero.

items.title: Purchase confirmation
items.overview: The browser has received the selected order response. The stop is immediately before displaying its confirmation. Captured order values and the later screen observation establish the result.
